recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the FHIR-14882 invariant; any future work on expansion lifecycle/status modeling should start from the later FHIR-18564/FHIR-18685 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-14882 asked to clarify the meaning and use of required ValueSet.status when a ValueSet instance is carrying only an expansion. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said to create an invariant requiring status = active when only status and expansion are populated.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was applied as svn 13467. Git commit 6df7f5cfc26ca11762fb1d16dbebe9a2dbe8ad88, titled "GF#1488 - Add ValueSet invariant for status must = 'active' if expansion is present and compose is absent," added the old invariant to source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Later Published ValueSet issues FHIR-18564 and FHIR-18685 revisited the same rule. FHIR-18564 objected that an expansion might exist for a non-active value set, and FHIR-18685 resolved to remove vsd-11 and clarify that ValueSet.status applies to the value set definition/compose and associated metadata while expansions are stateless. Commit fbcbcb6ac4f574b7f9859cc6bf36e54befb5d312 applied that later decision, and both related issues already have combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current ValueSet source is in build scope and already says ValueSet.status applies to compose/metadata, expansions do not have a state, and $expand returns status/version from the source definition when available; the obsolete active-only invariant is absent.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue objected to the active-only ValueSet expansion invariant introduced for FHIR-14882; already represented on the combined branch by aba41a9ee708c3d2d698affb95638481d8855e4e.

Later Published issue supplied the replacement semantics by removing vsd-11 and clarifying status/expansion statelessness; already represented on the combined branch by 5520278da4de3ef5596119150d2c5ef2b546b20f.
